🚀 Hackathon success in Petropavl! 🎉 We’re thrilled to celebrate the completion of the NASA Space Apps Challenge. A huge shoutout to our incredible participants who brought their innovative ideas to life. Congratulations to our winners for their outstanding projects! Your hard work and dedication inspire us all. Thank you to everyone who joined us in this exciting journey. Let’s continue to explore the cosmos together!  Also, special thanks to our mentors and judges!
